answer.reason: The verses state what David did with the tent: he pitched it for the ark and the ark was set in it with offerings.

clauses.english: was pitched by David in the city of David as a place for the ark of God
clauses.quote: prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent

clauses.english: received the ark of God, set in its midst with burnt offerings and peace offerings before God
clauses.quote: set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it

doubts: 2CH 1:4 only repeats that David pitched a tent at Jerusalem, so it is not cited separately.
